purpose: Concrete source obligations to reconcile into the complete capability ledger; not a claim of complete registry discovery or executed parity.

entries.requirement: Sprite/depth reconstruction, embedded FSOM, replacement meshes/textures, cache precedence and invalidation
entries.acceptance_journey: Load an original object family in 3D, verify replacement precedence and reconstructed fallback, rotate and pick it after cache reload.

entries.requirement: Full2D, Hybrid2D, Full3D and perspective/first-person camera transitions
entries.acceptance_journey: Switch supported modes while interacting, preserving camera/picks and actual world state.

entries.requirement: Neighboring subworlds/facades, city roads/foliage, neighborhood geometry and thumbnails
entries.acceptance_journey: Discover, inspect and enter a property with correct facade/thumbnail/neighbors; edit and reverify its representation.

entries.requirement: Room lighting/shadows, sky, particles and source-driven weather
entries.acceptance_journey: Change room structure and time/weather inputs; inspect lighting, particles, visibility and context recovery.

entries.requirement: Instanced career/grade/role-matched robot-factory, restaurant and nightclub shifts
entries.acceptance_journey: Match eligible players, respect ignore lists/roles, complete rounds, persist progression and return after disconnect.

entries.requirement: Single-object earning cohorts, economic history and dynamic payout tuning
entries.acceptance_journey: Earn via supported object chains, apply an idempotent tuning period and verify authority-derived newspaper/economic projection.

entries.requirement: Durable visits, Top 100 and category-scaled visitor/property bonuses
entries.acceptance_journey: Visit across a period boundary, calculate once, rerun after failure and verify ranking and bonus without double payment.

entries.requirement: Rack stock/try/buy/defaults/pricing, player object sales, business discounts
entries.acceptance_journey: One user stocks/prices a shop, another buys an owned item/outfit; recover lost receipt with correct two-party ownership and balance.

entries.requirement: Bilateral money/items/property trade including optional furnishings and ownership side effects
entries.acceptance_journey: Exchange a furnished property through mutual consent, interrupt settlement, verify all-or-nothing durable ownership and reject community-lot trade.

entries.requirement: Wear, breakage, repair/skill effects, harvest components and upgrades
entries.acceptance_journey: Use until worn/broken, repair and upgrade, verify costs/tuning/reinitialization/value and persistence.

entries.requirement: Size/floor upgrades, roommate costs, object capacity/disable rules and discounts
entries.acceptance_journey: Expand a lot and floors, verify capacity and costs with roommate changes; reject invalid over-budget edits.

entries.requirement: Distinct community donations/build rights/sale rules and mayor property actions
entries.acceptance_journey: Operate a community lot with builder/donor/visitor roles; verify donation value/wear treatment and denied private-sale paths.

entries.requirement: Six skills/locks, lot skill modes, welcome boosts and directional relationships
entries.acceptance_journey: Train and lock skills, interact in different lot modes, reload and verify asymmetric relationships/economic multipliers.

entries.requirement: Multi-actor acceptance/timeouts, held/contained objects, slots/reach, suits/accessories, headlines and pet rigs
entries.acceptance_journey: Complete and decline multi-actor interactions; hold/place objects and change outfit/rig while observing contact, picks and recovery.

entries.requirement: Timed tuning/events, participation dedup, configured age gifts, game token attributes and global cooldowns
entries.acceptance_journey: Run a configured event/age boundary, retry after replacement and verify one reward, correct eligibility and durable cooldown.

entries.requirement: Nominations/eligibility/voting/failsafe/winner/mayor replacement and announcements
entries.acceptance_journey: Complete an election period with eligible accounts; recover scheduled boundary and verify one authoritative outcome and recipient notices.

entries.requirement: 30 server registrations reconciled to client and server-only controllers
entries.acceptance_journey: Qualify each registered handler separately with participants, actual outcomes, cancellation, private-state boundaries and recovery.

entries.requirement: Original nonredeemable Simoleon casino games, owner bankroll management, bets and payouts
entries.acceptance_journey: Play each supported game with isolated game-currency accounts, recover mid-hand/reply loss and verify hidden data and balances without real-world value.

entries.requirement: Object/GUID creation, BHAV graphs, tracing/stack inspection, resource-specific editors, PIFF/mesh/avatar work and undo/redo
entries.acceptance_journey: Create/edit an object, step live behavior and inspect stack, undo/redo, cook/export/reload and retain exact behavior/dependencies.

entries.requirement: Full deployed family/dependency denominator across household, pets, commercial, jobs and activities
entries.acceptance_journey: Qualify complete family interactions and patch/global/tuning/mesh variants; record missing distribution rights/resources as unresolved gates.
